title: Constant fibre dimension opens covering fibre component generic points
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be a scheme morphism and $U\subseteq T$ open such that $f|_U$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. There are opens $V_n\subseteq X$, indexed by $n\in\mathbb N$, such that every point $x$ over $U$ which is generic [def-sc-generic-point] in an irreducible component [def-weil-irreducible-components] of its ordinary fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] belongs to some $V_n$, and for every $y\in V_n$ the local dimension [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] of its fibre at $y$ is $n$.

source.place: Tag 054T, Lemma 37.22.9 (constant relative dimension opens), and Tag 054U, first sentence of the proof.

proof.text: Obtain dimension opens V_n with fibrewise dense union from the core theorem.

For x over U, the union of inverse images of V_n in its fibre is open, since each fibre inclusion is continuous. The cover theorem puts its component generic point asFiber x in this union. Unpack union membership and use fiberι_asFiber to obtain x in V_n. Pair this coverage with the dimension clause of the core theorem.

proof_origin.place: Tag 054T and first sentence of Tag 054U; explicit open-union and fibre inclusion proof by F1

lean.statement:
theorem exists_fibre_dimension_strata_of_flat_restrict
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)] :
    ∃ V : ℕ → X.Opens,
      (∀ x : X, f x ∈ U →
        f.asFiber x ∈ genericPoints (f.fiber (f x)) → ∃ n : ℕ, x ∈ V n) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : X), x ∈ V n →
        topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber x) = (n : WithBot ℕ∞))
